first_actual_failure: GnOuGoAgentWebHostTests.ChatConversationsApi_ReturnsExistingMcpStoreConversationsWithoutLlm: collector port 41645 was already in use at host startup.
cause: The fixture selected collector ports with temporary TcpListeners and closed them before Kestrel startup, allowing another host to claim a selected port.
generic_fix: All callers of the shared telemetry host arguments now build through a test-only helper that binds loopback port-zero sockets once and hands those same bound sockets to Kestrel. Container disposal closes sockets that were never handed off.

controlled_red.failure: The competing binder acquired a selected collector port before app.StartAsync; Assert.Throws observed no exception.

includes: Socket release when a host is disposed before startup
Cold host and separate-process discovery restart

limitation: This retains the failed historical CI result. A new CI run is required for the corrected source; local passes are not a remote CI pass.
